searchText: I think some mechanism to indicate when a soon-to-be-deprecated endpoint is "safe to remove" from clients' codebase, or some sort of "available til x hardfork" would be nice typically it'd be 'deprecated' and we'd delete it after a couple of hard forks but ad-hoc... i'm happy with deprecated, just would be nice to have a firm idea of when its 'safe' to remove i guess Yeah would be a good idea to add a note as to in which hard fork each deprecated call can be removed. we could put 'deprecated in XX, can be removed in YY' in description... could alternatively (or also) have an entry in changes log. Would need to be remembered i guess
